theorems.statement: For octonions, the scalar projection of the associator vanishes while the full associator need not vanish.
theorems.witness: [e1,e2,e4] = 2 e7 has scalar part 0 and norm 2

theorems.statement: Scalar/unit-readout associativity, together with unital bilinearity, positive norm composition and alternativity, excludes n=7 and selects n=3.
PDT primitives imply a separating/tomographically complete family of records or effects that detects every nonzero associator direction.
